w014_anchor_pattern_analysis.finding: In Migration 041 (lines 369-395), current_version_id was added to states, districts, pcs, and constituencies as a plain nullable foreign key (REFERENCES <version_table>(id) ON DELETE SET NULL). However, plain foreign keys cannot declaratively enforce that current_version_id belongs to the same anchor entity or that is_current is true.
w014_anchor_pattern_analysis.anchor_temporal_truth_evaluation: Migration 041 added valid_from, valid_to, and is_current to anchor tables in addition to version tables. For mandals, duplicating valid_from and valid_to on the anchor introduces conflicting sources of truth. The refined architecture isolates temporal validity intervals (valid_from, valid_to) strictly to public.mandal_versions, while public.mandals holds only current_version_id and entity-level is_active.

current_version_id_integrity_design.problem: A plain FK public.mandals.current_version_id -> public.mandal_versions.id permits two integrity violations: (1) pointing to a version of a DIFFERENT mandal, and (2) pointing to a version where is_current = false.

layer_1_composite_foreign_key.mandals_foreign_key: FOREIGN KEY (current_version_id, id) REFERENCES public.mandal_versions(id, mandal_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
layer_1_composite_foreign_key.guarantee: PostgreSQL engine guarantees that mandals.current_version_id MUST resolve to a mandal_versions row with the EXACT same mandal_id. Cross-mandal version assignment is physically impossible.

layer_2_currentness_trigger.event: BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF current_version_id ON public.mandals
layer_2_currentness_trigger.logic: Asserts that when NEW.current_version_id IS NOT NULL, SELECT 1 FROM public.mandal_versions WHERE id = NEW.current_version_id AND is_current = true must return a row; otherwise aborts with exception 23514.
layer_2_currentness_trigger.guarantee: Guarantees that mandals.current_version_id points strictly to a version where is_current = true.

layer_3_reciprocal_version_trigger.event: AFTER UPDATE OF is_current ON public.mandal_versions
layer_3_reciprocal_version_trigger.logic: When a version transitions from is_current = true to false, if public.mandals.current_version_id pointed to this version, it is cleared (SET current_version_id = NULL) unless a successor active version is simultaneously assigned.
layer_3_reciprocal_version_trigger.guarantee: Prevents orphaned active pointers when a version is retired.

owned_fields: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY (Immutable stable canonical anchor identifier)
current_version_id UUID (Pointer to active version, enforced by composite FK and trigger)
is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT true (Entity-level institutional existence)
prohibited_duplicate_fields: valid_from (Prohibited on anchor; lives exclusively on mandal_versions)
valid_to (Prohibited on anchor; lives exclusively on mandal_versions)

owned_fields: id UUID PRIMARY KEY (Immutable version surrogate key)
valid_from DATE NOT NULL (Statutory interval start)
valid_to DATE (Statutory interval end; NULL if current)
is_current BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false (Fail-closed active flag)
metadata JSONB (Gazette citation and legal audit notes)

constraints.name: uq_mandal_versions_no_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist (mandal_id WITH =, (daterange(valid_from, valid_to, '[)')) WITH &&)

constraints.name: chk_mandal_versions_current_invariants
constraints.definition: CHECK ((is_current = false) OR (is_current = true AND valid_to IS NULL))

quarantine_rules: No 2016 versions are fabricated for any of the 23 discrepancies.
No synthetic geometry splits are created.
No inferred spatial containment is encoded into statutory relationship tables (mandal_constituency_map).
Historical version rows are created ONLY for temporal intervals where authoritative statutory Gazette evidence is explicitly verified.
